therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CAR-T cell therapy targeting CD19 combined with PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced anti-tumor T-cell activity through direct CD19 targeting and immune checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma

results.target_engagement_evidence: Peak CAR-T cell levels measured: 60.22-167.88 cells/μL across cohorts
safety_signals: Serious adverse events including febrile neutropenia, anemia, GI perforation
results.dose_information: Single infusion of KTE-C19 CAR-T cells with atezolizumab administered at different time points (1, 14, or 21 days after KTE-C19), preceded by cyclophosphamide and fludarabine conditioning
